conventions.frame: X = body axis, flow +X, nose at x = 0, Z up, right handed; mm and deg
conventions.azimuth: psi about +X from +Z, right handed: e_r = (0, -sin psi, cos psi), e_t = (0, -cos psi, -sin psi); blade i at psi = 120 i; rotor turns +psi (clockwise seen from upstream, as data/blade_design.json)
conventions.theta_internal_layout: layout_internal uses theta from +Z toward +Y, i.e. theta = -psi
conventions.blade_frame: origin on the hinge axis at H = (hinge_x, 0, 0) + hinge_r e_r; e_s span (deployed = e_r), e_c chord along the pin (= e_t, toward the LE), e_n = e_s x e_c thickness (deployed = +X, suction side)
conventions.fold: rotation by +fold about e_t: e_s = cos f e_r - sin f e_x, e_n = sin f e_r + cos f e_x; 0 = deployed, fold_deg = stowed (tip forward over the static tail)
conventions.transform: blade_to_world(fold, psi): 4x4 with columns (e_s, e_t, e_n, H)
conventions.pitch_axis: pitch point P(r) = (s, lead, aft) in the blade frame at PITCH_AXIS chord; r = sqrt((hinge_r + s)^2 + lead^2) is the deployed perpendicular radius
conventions.twist: as bem.py: chord vs plane of rotation in the section plane normal to the local pitch axis, + = LE upstream
conventions.pocket_azimuth: az relative to the blade azimuth psi, + toward e_t (direction of rotation)

selection.rule: feasible: pin cover in hub core >= 2, stowed heel >= 0.5 inside the spinner, heel face >= magnet D + 0.6, stop block >= magnet H + recess + MIN_WALL + 0.6, ear clear >= 0.5, neighbour >= 1, swept root >= ROOT_CLEAR from the static tail, hub wall >= MIN_WALL; then max of the smallest margin (pin cover, heel, magnet room), ties to the smallest hinge-to-static-tail offset (front 10 only adds keep-out the internal layout does not need)

axis.poly_variable: t = (r - r_root) / (r_tip - r_root), numpy.polyval order (highest first)
axis.derivation: for each station the aft offset is solved (bisection) so the highest point of the stowed section is flush with the hull (proud 0); lead is the per-station optimum (golden section) that minimises the flush pocket depth, then fitted by polynomials and iterated with the section planes (they depend on d aft/ds)

fold_choice.reason: stowed depth and keep-out barely change with fold (the axis re-solves); the fold angle mostly sets the deployed cone (+1 deg cone per +1 deg fold). 90 deg gives a mean cone close to the BEM nominal 12 deg with the tip bending forward; see fold_study

stowed_max_over_hull.note: highest point of each stowed part above the hull envelope (normal); design value 0 (flush), residual = solver tolerance

pocket_depth.note: radial depth below the hull of the pocket floor (blade inner surface - clearance 0.3 under the aero span, 0.8 under the root, side clearance 0.8); keepout_r = floor - MIN_WALL along the hull normal = the largest radius internal parts may use under a pocket. Half-width is about az_center (relative to the blade azimuth).

pocket_summary.floor_print_rule: both shells print +x down; the floor may rise at most tan(45 deg) per mm going forward (printable_floor), so the root-notch ramp and the pocket's forward end are cut as <= 45 deg ramps, no supports

hub_slot.note: hinge-plane coords of blade 0 (r_e along e_r, tau along the pin), swept root over fold 0..stowed in 1 deg steps, + run clearance; cut the hub and the spinner to this per blade

concept: Hub (printed, rotating): body of revolution from the hub front (static tail end + HUB_GAP) to the shaft end, outer surface = hull - spinner wall - gap. Bore 8 mm close-running with a D-flat; one M3 cup-point grub (ISO 4029) radial on the D-flat, between two blades.
Clevis per blade: the blade root ends in a full-width knuckle (cylinder about the pin) that sits in a slot between two hub ears; the 3 mm pin runs TANGENTIALLY through ear, knuckle, ear.

Pins: ISO 8734 parallel pins pressed into the ears (printed PIN_D + 2 PRESS_FIT hole), knuckle bore PIN_D + 2 CLEAR_ROTATE (radial per side). They go in along e_t through a 3 mm channel from the hub core surface; the spinner shell covers both channel ends and retains the pins (folding-prop practice).
Deployed stop: a heel tab under the knuckle; under thrust its leading face lands on the hub front ring (stop face at x = hinge_x - heel_t/2), which takes the flapwise moment.

Spinner (printed, rotating): 1.25 mm shell from the hub front to the blunt tip with three slots (slot table). Slides on from aft, keys on the slots, and is held by one axial M3 screw into a tapped hole in the shaft end; the hub's aft face bears on the spinner's inner aft wall, so rotor thrust goes hub -> spinner -> M3 screw -> shaft (the grub only locks rotation and holds the hub during assembly).
Detents: N52 4x2 magnet pairs, heel face <-> stop face (deployed) and root inner face <-> boss on the static notch floor (stowed). No springs.

grub.note: radial M3 tapped hole (2.5 drill) at an azimuth between two blades; clearance = hole axis to swept root surface minus the 1.25 mm drill radius

pin.standard: ISO 8734 parallel pin 3 x 22 (VERIFY stock length)
pin.retention: spinner shell covers both channel ends

spinner.retention: axial M3 screw into a tapped hole in the shaft end (M3 tap, 8 deep)
spinner.slot: per blade: hub_slot table (x, slot floor r_e, half-width tau) + run clearance

hub.loads_source: blade_design.json: layout_axis_check (hinge 116, 14, solved curved axis); torque from performance.envelope_up_to_runaway
hub.load_note: ESTIMATES, first-order statics: stop force = flap moment / stop lever; pin reaction = stop force + blade thrust (same direction); stresses on projected areas. Compare with PETG/PLA strength in the report; the 2.5 m/s case is the BEM worst case.

detents.magnet: 4 x 2 mm N52 disc, axial (MAGNET in params.py)
detents.per_blade: 2 in the blade (heel face, root inner face), 1 in the hub stop face, 1 in the static tail notch floor; 12 in total
detents.polarity: every pair attracting; all blades identical, all hub and all tail magnets identical

rows.source: https://www.jc-magnetics.com/Magnet-N52-4mm-2mm-Discs; 1.03 lb (jc) / 0.91 lb (https://themagnetbaron.com/collections/4mm-disc-magnets), magnet to steel plate
https://www.jc-magnetics.com/Magnet-N52-4mm-2mm-Discs; 1.03 lb (jc) / 0.91 lb (https://themagnetbaron.com/collections/4mm-disc-magnets), magnet to steel plate

calibration.note: k_design = lowest 4x2 catalogue pull / model; applied to every model force

detents.note: Forces: surface-charge model scaled by k (catalogue pull / model). Contact faces are plastic; magnets sit magnet_recess below them. A weaker stowed hold for flow-opening in water: deepen the recesses (see force_vs_gap).

blade_mass.note: ESTIMATE: solid PLA (1.24 g/cm3, same assumption as the BEM study); worst-case gravity moment about the pin = m g x cg distance from the pin axis

interference.criteria: static tail: swept blade never below the pocket floor (floor already includes 0.3/0.8 clearance); ears: no blade point in the pin + 2 mm zone; neighbours >= 1 mm at any fold pair; deployed blades apart; heel inside the spinner at both ends; deployed aero span above the hull
